title: I GOT A PLAYBILL PIC AT #TIFF26!!!! 😭 #theatrekids #musicals #playbil...
transcript: We got a playbill! I meant it for the premiere of the debut, and they gave us a playbill! I'm obsessed. So this movie is about a fairy tale, and I guess this must be the production, and they've given us an actual, full, real playbill. I'm crying. It's a musical! Stop. I'm losing my mind. Oh, my gosh! These cast BIOS. So excited to know what this means. This is the best day of my life, actually.
